name: Word of Radiance

targets.description: Each creature of your choice that you can see in a 5-foot Emanation from you.

summary: Chosen creatures you can see within 5 feet of you fail a Con save to take 1d6 Radiant damage.
text: Burning radiance bursts from you in a 5-foot Emanation. Each creature of your choice that you can see in it makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 1d6 Radiant damage on a failure. The damage becomes 2d6 at character level 5, 3d6 at level 11 and 4d6 at level 17.
